subject: Re: HavenBank SIG request — BCP/DR artifacts & RTO/RPO evidence
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@havenbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
Cc: HavenBank Security <sec@havenbank.com>, procure@havenbank.com
Date: 2026-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: BCP/DR artifacts & RTO/RPO evidence for SIG review

Irene —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG review we need a focused set of BCP/DR artifacts that demonstrate your operational commitments and the evidence behind your RTO/RPO numbers. Can you provide the following by EOD 2026-07-30?

- A single RTO/RPO matrix showing committed targets per region/service and the most recent sampled measurements/test results.
- Executive summary of the latest failover/drill (date, duration, outcome) and the runbook used.
- KV cache warm timings and any warm-start telemetry for the last live test.
- Restore/restore-trace logs for a representative recovery (ideally <6 months).
- Designated DR activation contact list and escalation playbook.
- Mapping to SOC 2 control IDs (if available) or SIG/CAIQ crosswalk references.

We expect most items to be redacted for customer data; a sanitized export is fine. Also please indicate any artifacts that require a witness call / controlled access (telemetry extracts, live traces). If easier we can schedule a brief 30-minute session the week of 7/27 to review.

Appreciate it — we are trying to close this review quickly.

Best,
Sara Liu
Sr. Information Risk Manager
HavenBank
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@havenbank.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-20T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: BCP/DR artifacts & RTO/RPO evidence for SIG review

Sara —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested; below is our proposed scope and immediate next steps so we stay aligned on redaction and controlled-access items:

1) RTO/RPO matrix: we will share a CSV that lists per-service commitments (hosted API, Dedicated, Private) and the sampled measurements from our June 2026 tabletop and warm-standby test. File: redwood_rto_rpo_matrix_2026-06.csv (we will provide a sanitized copy if you confirm scope).

2) Failover summary + runbook: executive summary plus the operative runbook used in our May 21, 2026 warm-failover test. File: runbook-failover-summary-20260521.pdf.

3) KV cache warm timings: we can attach extracted traces from the test run (KV warm and prefix cache timings) — kv-warm-cache-trace-20260521.log. Note these contain internal hostnames and timestamps; we will sanitize host identifiers.

4) Restore traces: we can pull a representative restore trace (anonymized); timeline and size metrics included in the CSV above.

5) DR activation contacts: we will provide the escalation manifest (names, roles, oncall windows) with personal contact redacted where necessary; the internal oncall list is operational but we can provide role-based contacts for SIG.

6) SOC2/SIG mapping: we have a short mapping doc that correlates our operational controls to common SIG/SOC 2 control IDs — will add inline notes in the CSV.

We anticipate the telemetry extracts (KV/restore traces) will need controlled delivery. If you confirm which attributes you need sanitized (hostnames, IPs, timestamps) we will produce a redaction plan.

Tentative delivery: sanitized CSV + runbook summary by 2026-07-24; controlled telemetry extract available for secured transfer and/or witness call.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_rto_rpo_matrix_2026-06.csv; runbook-failover-summary-20260521.pdf; kv-warm-cache-trace-20260521.log

Would you prefer a Drive share with viewer restrictions or a secured SFTP link for the telemetry bundle? Also propose two witness-call slots: Tue 2026-07-28 10:00 PT or Wed 2026-07-29 15:00 PT for a 30-minute walkthrough.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Sr. Trust & Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: BCP/DR artifacts & RTO/RPO evidence for SIG review

Irene — quick internal note before we send:

- Legal has asked that any artifacts that could contain customer identifiers (restore traces, hostnames in KV logs) be redacted using the following rule set: replace hostnames/IPs with stable pseudonyms (host-01, host-02), truncate request IDs to prefix only, and zero-out any customer-facing payloads.
- Security would like the telemetry extracts hashed and checksummed before transfer and a one-time access token for the Drive share.
- Ops requests we include a short appendix listing the test conditions (load profile, region, instance types) so SIG reviewers can interpret timing numbers.

Irene, please attach a brief redaction instructions file when you send the sanitized materials. I created a draft: redaction-instructions-IR-20260721.md (internal). Also flag anything you think needs an NDA or escrow process.

Markus
VP, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@havenbank.com>

Subject: Delivering sanitized BCP/DR artifacts — next steps and witness-call options

Sara —

Following internal review and Markus' redaction guidance, please find the sanitized artifacts attached to this message (stubs below). We removed/normalized host identifiers, truncated request IDs, and removed customer payloads as discussed.

Delivered artifacts (sanitized):
- redwood_rto_rpo_matrix_2026-06_sanitized.csv (includes per-service commitments, sampled metrics, and SOC 2/SIG crosswalk column)
- runbook-failover-summary-20260521_sanitized.pdf (executive summary, timeline, and key decision points)
- witness-call-telemetry-extracts.zip (KV warm timings & representative restore trace — hashed and checksummed)

We will share the telemetry ZIP via a restricted Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3D-example-share) with one-time access tokens; MD5 checksums are embedded in the folder README.

Proposed witness-call slots (30 min):
- Tue 2026-07-28 10:00 PT
- Wed 2026-07-29 15:00 PT

Please confirm preferred slot and whether you need us to include any of our engineering leads on the call (ops lead / reliability engineer). If you need additional artifacts (raw restore trace beyond the representative sample) we can provision under an NDA and schedule a controlled access session.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the review.

--
